title: A monoatomic ideal gas cycle of isothermal, isochoric and adiabatic processes: heat in and out, temperature and pressure ratios and the efficiency
summary: A gas cylinder runs the cycle: isothermal expansion on a hot bath, isochoric cooling on a cold bath, adiabatic compression. For V2/V1 = 8 the run measures T_a = 4 T_c, heat out 1.125 nRT_a below heat in 2.08 nRT_a, and the same efficiency at 300 K and 600 K; P_a is 8 P_b, not 4 - answer (A), (B), (C).
subject: Physics
topic: A cycle of isothermal, isochoric and adiabatic processes for a monoatomic ideal gas - heat flows, temperature and pressure ratios, efficiency
subtopics: Isothermal process: dU = 0, Q = W = nRT ln(V2/V1), P proportional to 1/V
Isochoric process: W = 0, Q = n C_V dT
Adiabatic process: Q = 0, T V^(gamma - 1) constant; gamma = 5/3 for a monoatomic gas
Efficiency of a cycle, eta = (Q_in - Q_out)/Q_in
concepts: The adiabat gives T_a/T_c = (V2/V1)^(2/3) = 4 for V2/V1 = 8 - statement (C)
Heat absorbed on ab = nRT_a ln 8 = 2.1 nRT_a exceeds the heat released on bc = (3/2) nR (3/4) T_a = 1.125 nRT_a - statement (A)
Both heats scale with T_a, so eta = 1 - (3/2)(1 - r^(-2/3))/ln r depends only on r - statement (B)
On the isotherm P_a/P_b = V2/V1 = 8, not 4 - statement (D) false

methods: Solved independently: adiabat T_a/T_c = 8^(2/3) = 4 (C); Q_bc = 9/8 nRT_a < Q_ab = 3 ln 2 nRT_a (A); eta independent of T_a (B); P_a/P_b = 8 (D false) - answer A, B, C
sympy: states, heats and eta(r) symbolically; T_a absent from eta

First law integrated numerically along each leg (scipy), the adiabat from dT/dV = -P/(n C_V): T_c = 75.0 K from 300 K; Q_ab = 5.187 kJ, Q_bc = 2.806 kJ; eta the same at 150, 300, 600, 1200 K for r = 2, 4, 8, 16
With the paper's ln 2 = 0.7: Q_ab = 2.1 nRT_a > 1.125 nRT_a, eta = 0.464
